curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: select the sounds /k/, /j/, and /l/, and words with the target sounds from a text

mission.title: select the sounds /k/, /j/, and /l/, and words with the target sounds from a text

interactions.retryHint: Listen to the first sound: /k/, kite.

interactions.prompt: Which sound begins the word jug?
interactions.retryHint: Say jug slowly and catch its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Sort each word by its first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap its sound group.
interactions.feedback: Great! You grouped the /k/, /j/, and /l/ words.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Read: Juma lifts a little jug. Which word has /l/?
interactions.retryHint: Find the word beginning with l.

interactions.prompt: Read: The cat jumps near Lake Kivu. Which word begins with /j/?
interactions.retryHint: Look for the letter j in the text.

interactions.prompt: Match each target sound to a word from: Kamau likes lemon juice.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a sound, then its matching word.
interactions.feedback: Super! You selected all three sounds and words from the text.
interactions.retryHint: Check the first letter of Kamau, juice, and lemon.
